name: Phenol and acetone (cumene)
principle: Benzene is alkylated with propylene to cumene over a zeolite catalyst, cumene is oxidised to cumene hydroperoxide and cleaved to phenol and acetone. Technip Energies Badger cumene technology, with ExxonMobil catalysts, has been licensed 36 times since 1996 and single trains reach 750 kt/yr cumene.
